confirmHome: Home the machine? Check that the axes are clear.
confirmPulse: Confirm this single pulse? Stay at the machine with laser protection and a clear work area.
confirmLaser: Confirm this laser controller action? Reset abandons the job and may invalidate position.
confirmPrinting: Change this setting during the print or its pause?
laserMotionNote: M5 before every move · feed 600 mm/min · physically verify travel limits. No motorized Z axis reported.
fabcoreHomed: Homed from FabCore; limits checked by firmware.
firmwareLimits: Homing and limits checked by firmware.
readOnly: Read only: controls are restricted to an administrator.
resetNote: Reset abandons the job and may invalidate position. No automatic unlock. This network-dependent button does not replace the hardware stop.
operatorPresent: I am at the machine with laser protection and a clear work area.
pulseNote: Setpoint calculated from $30; this percentage does not measure optical power.
pulseUnavailable: Laser test disabled until $30 and laser mode $32 are read.
cc2Note: CC2: hotend and controller fans are read-only; at least two seconds between commands.
